anomalies.disposition: Accepted as an orchestration-delay and target-date metadata finding. GitHub Actions records the scheduled run as created and started at 2026-08-27T00:45:40Z and successfully completed at 00:47:29Z. Its ledger reports health `ok`, zero fetch, extraction, and access failures, a coherent state-hash chain, a 30-day lookback encompassing 2026-08-26, and two insertions. No collection loss is observable in the reviewed corpus. Retained as a target-date metadata defect, not a corpus-integrity failure. After this checkpoint review, remediation should make the logical collection date explicit and add regression coverage for scheduled runs delayed past UTC midnight.
